ACCCON: old (acc AND FE) OR flip_screen = new acc EOR 1 iff D = NOT flip_screen at a flip. Verified: ACCCON writers are only this handler (D:=new, shown_screen:=D together), render_reset (D=0, shown_screen=0, pending=0; its copy loop's acc_main/acc_shadow have D=0), render_to_main (under SEI: D=0, shown=0, pending=0), cpu_sees_back/main, unpack_for_play, kindcache_build (X/Y bits only, under SEI); no ACCCON write via &FE34 or other names elsewhere, and the MOS calls in play (OSBYTE &0A, bank 5's &13,&81,&0D,&0E,&0F,&E9,&B2) do not touch ACCCON. flip_screen is written only at player_done as back = shown_screen EOR 1, read after wait_for_flip (pending clear); render has no exit bypassing player_done; render_pass is called only at wait_for_timer_281a, followed directly by SEI and set_flip_field (the only setter of pending); render_reset/render_start (only at game start, 2391) and render_to_main cannot run between player_done and set_flip_field; with pending clear the interrupt cannot change shown_screen. So at every flip D = shown_screen = NOT flip_screen and the written byte, shown_screen and pending are identical. Cycles at a pending flip: old BPL not taken 2 + AND# 2 + ORA abs 4 = 8; new BMI taken (same page) 3 + EOR# 2 = 5: 3 saved. Stale match without pending: old BPL taken across page 4, new 2+3 = 5 (+1, rare). Bytes: +3 (JMP) -3 (AND#+ORA abs -> EOR#) = 0.
